3216|13f1d3f9.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|13f1d3f9.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3432|c1a3099b.name: Mankrik
3432|c1a3099b.text:
I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, $c, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.

He claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!

3484|b1b31af6.name: Kil'hala
3484|b1b31af6.text: Dat's da attitude! Grab a needle and thread and let's get jammin'!

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3703|a0a64f07.name: Krulmoo Fullmoon
3703|a0a64f07.text: This blue leather does draw the eye, I know. You see, we have a great many eager recruits running around here, hunting and slaying with more enthusiasm than wisdom. One must take precautions.

3704|f0b17ebd.name: Mahani
3704|f0b17ebd.text: You still have lessons to learn before I may begin your training. In the meantime, perhaps Vhan, in Thunder Bluff can help you.

5885|f341dff7.name: Deino
5885|f341dff7.text: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

489-progress.name: Zenn Foulhoof
489-progress.text: What do you have for me, $N?  A lovely snack I presume?
489-progress.title: Seek Redemption!

490-progress.name: Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze
490-progress.text: Teldrassil cannot thrive with corruption tainting the land. Drive the Gnarlpine from this forest, once and for all.
490-progress.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg

6341-progress.name: Vesprystus
6341-progress.text: How may I help you?  Are you in need of transport?
6341-progress.title: The Bounty of Teldrassil

6342-progress.name: Laird
6342-progress.text: Have you come from Teldrassil?  Tell me, how is the fishing there?
6342-progress.title: Flight to Auberdine

6343-progress.name: Nessa Shadowsong
6343-progress.text: $N, you're back from Auberdine?  Did you speak with Laird?
6343-progress.title: Return to Nessa

748-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
748-progress.text: Do you have the paws and talons, $N?
748-progress.title: Poison Water

756-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
756-progress.text: $N, do you have the claws I sent you to gather? The Thunderhorn Water Well grows more tainted with each passing hour!
756-progress.title: Thunderhorn Totem

765-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
765-progress.text: I seethe with anger at the thought of the atrocities the Venture Co. is willing to perpetrate against us in the name of profit.
765-progress.title: Supervisor Fizsprocket

7833-progress.name: Vehena
7833-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Darkspear Trolls for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7833-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

844-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-progress.text: Have you collected the plainstrider beaks?
844-progress.title: Plainstrider Menace

853-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
853-progress.text: You have something from Apothecary Helbrim?
853-progress.title: Apothecary Zamah

922-progress.name: Rellian Greenspyre
922-progress.text:
Hello...

And how may I help you?
922-progress.title: Rellian Greenspyre

932-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
932-progress.text: Did you kill Lord Melenas yet? It is vital that he be taken care of quickly and quietly, $N. His continued existence is an embarrassment to us all.
932-progress.title: Twisted Hatred

96130-progress.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-progress.text: Have you found the big wolf?
96130-progress.title: Chakuyak

97936-progress.name: Yonn Deepcut
97936-progress.text: If you have the skill, I can train you.
97936-progress.title: Camping 101: Skinning

98430-accept.name: Perith Stormhoof
98430-accept.text:
Hail, $c. What brings you deep into such a dark and violent place?

I was sent here by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof as a part of our efforts to communicate with the gnolls that have taken residence. The rest of my mission must remain a secret, as do all things with the Longwalkers, the trusted scouts of our chieftain.

All you must know is our diplomacy was met with violence, and I fear I may be tonight's feast for the gnolls if you do not help me escape.

Are you up to the task?
98430-accept.title: The Longwalkers
